detection_limitations: BeaconHTTP profiles and response headers are operator-configurable.
The body rule requires response-body extraction or a native Suricata rule because default EVE HTTP output does not retain body content.
The TLS JA3/JA3S pair is not AdaptixC2-specific and JARM returned all zeros.
Sysmon EID 7 was disabled, so the upstream image-load sideload rule could not be exercised.
Single-event Sigma cannot assert periodicity; production intervals must be parameterized.
The Sysmon service mismatch rule requires unit-content enrichment because raw auditd PATH creation does not expose ExecStart.
The DNS rules are source-plus-listener validated, not grounded in Linux implant traffic; the reviewed release cannot emit such traffic.
The Linux Go TLS JA3/JA3S pair is shared with Sliver and is not framework-specific.
